# Send Email

**Provider:** [Google Workspace](../index)

Sends an email through the Gmail API for the authenticated user. Supports To,
Cc, Bcc, optional From, plain text or HTML bodies, and a dry-run mode that
builds the message without calling Gmail.

## Command Path

google-workspace, send-email

## Categories

email, communication

## Aliases

send gmail, email someone, compose email

## Provider Parameters

bearer_token, gmail_base_url, calendar_base_url

## Input Parameters

bcc, body_html, body_text, cc, dry_run, from, subject, to, user_id

## Output Fields

dry_run, id, label_ids, recipient_count, thread_id

## Input Schema

```yaml
type: object
properties:
  user_id:
    type: string
    description: Gmail user id or email address. Use "me" for the authenticated user.
  to:
    type: array
    description: Email recipients for the To header. CLI accepts comma-separated values.
    items:
      type: string
  cc:
    type: array
    description: Optional Cc recipients. CLI accepts comma-separated values.
    items:
      type: string
  bcc:
    type: array
    description: Optional Bcc recipients. CLI accepts comma-separated values.
    items:
      type: string
  from:
    type: string
    description: Optional From header. Must be allowed by the authenticated Gmail account.
  subject:
    type: string
    description: Email subject.
  body_text:
    type: string
    description: Plain text message body.
  body_html:
    type: string
    description: HTML message body. When provided, the message is sent as text/html.
  dry_run:
    type: boolean
    description: Build and validate the message without sending it.
required:
  - to
  - subject
```

## Output Schema

```yaml
type: object
properties:
  id:
    type: string
    description: Gmail message id returned after sending.
  thread_id:
    type: string
    description: Gmail thread id returned after sending.
  label_ids:
    type: array
    description: Gmail label ids returned after sending.
    items:
      type: string
  dry_run:
    type: boolean
    description: Whether the message was only built and not sent.
  recipient_count:
    type: integer
    description: Number of To, Cc, and Bcc recipients in the built message.
```
